say.never: `case IDLE:` is already written below the comment, and it stops both motors. Just above it, add `case SPIN_UP:`, which calls `runFlywheel()` and stops the roller, then `case SHOOT:`, which calls `runFlywheel()` and runs the roller at `CONSTANTS.INDEX_DUTY_CYCLE`. End each case with `break;`.
say.bit: Above `case IDLE:`, add `case SPIN_UP:` (`runFlywheel()`, roller stopped) and `case SHOOT:` (`runFlywheel()`, roller at `CONSTANTS.INDEX_DUTY_CYCLE`). End each with `break;`.

say.never: The `IDLE` row below the comment shows the shape of the table: a `case` for where the shooter is, and inside it `switch (wanted)`. Add the other two rows the same way, just before the outer `default:`. From SPIN_UP, `case SHOOT:` sets `system_state_` to SHOOT only `if (isAtSpeed())`, and `case IDLE:` sets it to IDLE. From SHOOT, `case SHOOT:` goes back to SPIN_UP `if (hasDipped())`, and `case IDLE:` sets it to IDLE. Every inner switch ends with `default: break;`, which means "ignore anything else". Don't forget a `break;` after each inner switch too.
say.bit: Copy the `IDLE` row's shape, before the outer `default:`. SPIN_UP wanting SHOOT goes to SHOOT once `isAtSpeed()`, wanting IDLE goes to IDLE; SHOOT wanting SHOOT goes back to SPIN_UP if `hasDipped()`, wanting IDLE goes to IDLE. `default: break;` ignores the rest.
